docs.t: Engine anti-ice, operations in icing conditions?
docs.x: Engine anti-ice, operations in icing conditions? ON for all ground and flight operations when icing conditions exist or are anticipated, except during climb and cruise below -40 °C SAT; ON prior to and during descent in icing conditions, including below -40 °C SAT The engine anti-ice must be ON during all ground and flight operations when icing conditions exist or are anticipated, except during climb and cruise when the temperature is below -40 °C SAT. The engine anti-ice must be ON prior to and during descent in icing conditions, including temperatures below -40 °C SAT. Note: Do not rely on airframe visual icing cues to turn engine anti-ice on. Use the temperature and visual moisture criteria specified in the icing conditions definition (Refer to LIM-GEN Icing Conditions Definition). Delaying the use of engine anti-ice until buildup is visible from the cockpit may result in severe engine damage and/or flameout. [LIM-70-00005469.0001001] Ice and Rain
